summary.text: Barbara Boyd is a Democratic member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 32, first elected in 1994.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative profile, she was born January 31, 1937, and holds a B.A. from Miles College and an M.A. and Ed.D. from the University of Alabama.
The profile describes her as a retired educator with more than 45 years in public and private education, including at Jacksonville State University, Gadsden State Community College and Miles College.
